mcarinfidelity.configuration.title: MCAR Infidelity Settings
mcarinfidelity.configuration.eligibility: Who is eligible and when. Age, family, and opt-in checks are fixed.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.minHeartsNo: Hearts needed with a player who is not the villager's partner.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.minHeartsPa: Hearts needed when the player is promised, engaged, or married to the villager.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.maxDistance: Maximum distance in blocks between participants.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.recentHurtS: Seconds after taking damage during which someone counts as busy.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.requestTime: Seconds before an unanswered player request expires.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.villagerThi: Seconds a villager waits before answering.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.declineCool: Seconds before asking the same target again after a decline.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.sessionDura: How long an interaction lasts when the scene is shown. Either participant can stop at any time.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.heartsOnCom: Hearts a villager gains when an interaction completes.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.moodOnCompl: Mood a villager gains when an interaction completes.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.wantsChildr: Chance a villager wants children, rolled once and kept. Personality shifts it. Only affects villagers that haven't rolled yet.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.nonPartnerU: For villagers who want children: chance per request to go without protection with someone who isn't their engaged or married partner.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.pregnancy.t: Conception and gestation. Time counts while the carrier is loaded or online.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.gestationDa: Length of a pregnancy in Minecraft days (20 minutes each).
mcarinfidelity.configuration.recoveryDay: Days after a birth before the mother can conceive again.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.notifyPregn: Pregnant players get a subtle hint a quarter of the way through.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.skippedSess: How long the fade to black lasts when the scene is skipped.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.privacyHome: Chance a villager only wants to be intimate at her own home. Rolled once per villager; personality shifts it.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.privacyAnyw: Chance a villager doesn't mind where, or who's around. Everyone else wants somewhere private.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.onlookerRad: Blocks within which another player or villager with line of sight counts as watching.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.privacyInte: Villagers who care about privacy stop if someone comes into view during a session.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.peakConcept: Chance of conception after an unprotected session on the day of ovulation.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.baseConcept: Chance of conception outside the fertile window.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.cycle.toolt: The cycle of female players and villagers. Follows the world clock.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.cycleLength: Length of a cycle in Minecraft days. Phases scale with it.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.cycleShareH: Hearts a villager needs before telling a non-partner about her cycle.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.offers.tool: Villagers making the first move. Players can always decline, or turn offers off.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.villagerOff: Allow villagers to make offers at all.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.offerCheckS: How often each player gets a roll for a spontaneous offer.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.spontaneous: Chance per roll when an eligible villager who likes you is nearby.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.offerSearch: How far away a villager can be to walk over and make an offer.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.offerCooldo: Real-time minutes before the same villager offers again.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.journalOffe: Chance a villager in her fertile window offers after sharing her cycle.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.escortTimeo: How long a villager leading you home waits before giving up.
Cheating and its consequences. Only villager partners react.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.promisedSev: Base severity when the cheater was promised.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.committedSe: Base severity when the cheater was engaged or married.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.initiatedMu: When the cheater asked or offered first.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.wasAskedMul: When the cheater was the one asked.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.witnessedMu: When the partner saw it happen.
Added to the multiplier for each earlier offense against the same partner.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.otherPartyS: Share of the severity held against the person they cheated with.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.heartsPerSe: Hearts a player loses with the wronged partner per point of severity.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.breakupThre: Grievance at which the wronged partner ends the relationship. Scaled by personality.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.grievanceDe: Grievance that fades per Minecraft day. Scaled by personality.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.refuseIntim: At or above this grievance, a villager won't be intimate with that person.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.evidenceMul: When it came out through a child.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.discovery.t: How affairs come out besides being seen: gossip, a child, or chance.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.gossipDelay: Real-time minutes before witnesses start talking.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.gossipChanc: Chance per minute that a witness near the wronged partner tells them.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.gossipRadiu: How close a witness has to be to the wronged partner to tell them.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.chanceDisco: Chance per Minecraft day that an undiscovered affair comes out anyway.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.chanceWindo: Days after which an affair can no longer come out by chance.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.exile.toolt: Permanent exile from a village for repeated cheating with multiple people.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.exileThresh: Total severity of discovered offenses in one village that gets a player exiled.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.exileMinPar: Those offenses must involve at least this many different people.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.exileGuards: Guards of the village attack exiled players inside its borders.
mcarinfidelity.configuration.exileWarnSe: How often exiled players inside the village are told to leave.
